en.headline: 13 commits across 2 repos, 5 issue actions on opencode
en.summary: On 2026-10-17, the user made **13 own commits** across two repositories, plus 28 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the 11 commits covered codemap initialization, an AI retry fix for empty content responses, summary page improvements including per-repo count pills and a teaser section, a CI rebase retry for push failures, a render font-size fix for Chinese badges, and a backup provider swap from Zen to OpenCode Go. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 2 commits corrected outdated knowledge docs about subcommand lists, bundled skill counts, and Windows ports, and added a remote branch deletion check. The user also performed 5 issue actions on `anomalyco/opencode`: commenting on #50823 about stale image reads after 5+ images in a session, commenting twice on #56113 about subagent `model_coming_soon` failures on MiMo-V2.6-Flash, and both commenting on and closing #55785 about the Go endpoint rejecting all image inputs with 400 errors. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 2 个仓库 13 次提交，opencode 上 5 次 issue 操作
